reasoning_content: 2027 exists already. Now the neue-fachplanungen page. The 030 test does: visits /administration/it-gesamtplan/neue-fachplanungen/2027, checks fp-9901 checkbox, removes disabled attr, clicks save, and expects .alert-info visible. Let's replicate.

action.command: cd /workspace; curl -s -b /tmp/cj4.txt -c /tmp/cj4.txt "http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/administration/it-gesamtplan/neue-fachplanungen/2027" -o /tmp/fp4.html -w "%{http_code}\n"; grep -oE 'id="fp-9901"' /tmp/fp4.html; echo "== POST =="; curl -s -b /tmp/cj4.txt -c /tmp/cj4.txt -o /tmp/fp5.html -w "%{http_code}\n" --data-urlencode "ds9901=on" --data-urlencode "btn-save=Fachplanungen anlegen" "http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site/administration/it-gesamtplan/neue-fachplanungen/2027"; grep -oE 'alert-[a-z]+' /tmp/fp5.html | sort -u; sed -n 's/.*<div class="alert alert-info">//p' /tmp/fp5.html | sed 's/<[^>]*>/ /g' | tr -s ' ' | head -c 300; echo; su - ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && ddev mysql -e "SELECT fk_gesamtplan,fk_dienststelle,geschlossen FROM fachplanung WHERE fk_gesamtplan=2027;"' 2>&1 | tail -5
